entities.name: Udaya III of Anuradhapura
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Udaya III was King of Anuradhapura in the 10th century, whose reign lasted from 964 to 972. He succeeded Sena III as King of Anuradhapura and was succeeded by Sena IV.
